data.title: 平冢静 · 遮阳凉亭黑金比基尼品酒的成熟韵致
data.description: 高档海滨度假村的私人木质凉亭内，平冢静身穿沉稳奢华的黑金系带比基尼，手持冰镇白葡萄酒高脚杯，饱满健美的高挑身段散发出无与伦比的成熟女性香气。
data.location: 私人海滩豪华木质卡巴纳凉亭
data.action: 坐在厚实白色软垫长椅上，单腿微屈，摇晃手中透明酒杯，唇角挂着半调侃半认真的诱人笑意
data.lighting: 斜阳将白色纱幔染上金晖，酒杯与水润肌肤反射耀眼金芒
data.camera: 低角度平视全景，展现结实平坦小腹与迷人身材曲线
data.promptProse: Shizuka Hiratsuka lounges with sophisticated ease upon a plush daybed inside a private wooden beach cabana during a breathtaking coastal sunset. Her tailored black halterneck bikini with metallic gold accents showcases her toned midriff and statuesque mature physique. Swirling a chilled glass of white wine as golden hour rays filter through billowing linen drapes, she greets the viewer with a sultry, knowing smirk.
data.animaCaption: Lounging in the beach cabana as sunset paints the linen drapes in gold, Shizuka swirls her wine glass with an alluring, confident smirk.
